description: Describes the fields one monitor type takes: which are required, which are optional, what each means and accepts, its default, and whether it is passed at the top level or inside typeFields. Call it before createMonitor, and before updateMonitor changes a type or a type-specific field: those tools do not describe these fields. Type names come from listMonitorTypes.

type.description: The monitor type, e.g. http, mqtt, snmp. Use listMonitorTypes for all options.

name: getMonitorTypeFields

commonFields.description: Fields every monitor type accepts, described on createMonitor

notes.description: Defaults applied when a field is omitted, and fields that become required depending on another

accepts.description: JSON Schema of the value: its type and any allowed values

in.description: Where to pass it: as an argument of createMonitor / updateMonitor, or inside their typeFields object

required.description: Fields a monitor of this type cannot work without. A create or type change without them is refused.
